text:
jena: quick question — trying to get the new Next.js seedkit + LlamaIndex example working with the Redwood SDK. Auth refresh seems to hang on first request, then retries kick in and I get 429s. Anyone seen this?

omar: Ugh. I saw something similar in my demo. Which SDK version?

jena: @omar using js-sdk@0.7.2 (edge build), next 14. Auth flow: client hits api route that proxies to /v1/generate with Authorization header from cookie. First call returns 401, client retries silently and then server starts sending 429s.

maria: Can you paste the api route snippet?

jena: Sure:

```js
export default async function handler(req, res) {
  const token = req.cookies['redwood_token']
  const r = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
    method: 'POST',
    body: JSON.stringify(req.body)
  })
  res.status(r.status).send(await r.text())
}
```

omar: a couple thoughts: 1) token in cookie might be stale and the sdk client normally handles refresh on the server side; 2) are you instantiating a new Redwood client per request? that can cause racey refreshes.

maria: we added a note in the seedkit about reusing client instances. Also watch for double-send in edge SSR.

kevin: We hit a similar issue in onboarding demo: if refresh flow triggers twice you end up in retry storm. Devex ticket open? Sam from SDK already looked?

sam: I took a look — SDK 0.7.2 has a bug where refreshLock isn't persisted across rapid invocations in edge runtime. Fix path: 0.7.3 will add an in-process refresh mutex and also expose `retryBackoff` config. Workaround: memoize client at module scope (caveat: edge functions per request behavior).

jena: Thanks @sam. For the seedkit docs, can we add a small snippet showing module-scope client + backoff config? I can PR.

sam: yes, please. Example:

```js
// lib/redwoodClient.js
import { RedwoodClient } from 'redwood-sdk'
export const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, retryBackoff: { baseMs: 200, maxMs: 2000 } })
```

maria: also add note about server->client signal for 401 to avoid silent retries: return 401 to browser so it can do client-side refresh before re-probing.

jena: will do. I'll open a PR to seedkit and add an eval test for auth refresh e2e so it doesn't regress.

kevin: awesome. can you add a tiny repro in the repo under /examples/next-auth-refresh? helps QA. :rocket:

jena: yep on it. thanks y'all :thumbsup:
